b2-21-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Happened to the Prices
b2-21-01.scenario: At the table in the hunting lodge, old Nini asks you, Konrád, what happened to the prices after the old world fell apart.
b2-21-01.prompt: Tell Nini what happened to the prices.
cues: Say that it was many times more
b2-21-01.target: Szinte hetek alatt az árak a többszörösére nőttek.
b2-21-01.english: Within weeks the prices rose to many times their level.
b2-21-01.canDo: I can say that something grew to two, three or four times its size (a kétszeresére, a négyszeresére nő)

b2-21-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Happened to the Money
b2-21-02.scenario: At dinner in the hunting lodge, old Nini asks you, Henrik, what the crisis did to the families' money.
b2-21-02.prompt: Tell Nini what happened to the families' money.
b2-21-02.target: A családok pénze drámai mértékben csökkent.
b2-21-02.english: The families' money fell to a dramatic degree.
b2-21-02.canDo: I can describe a change with mértékben and ütemben (jelentős mértékben, gyorsuló ütemben)

b2-21-03.title: Communicative Challenge: How Much Was Left
b2-21-03.scenario: By the fire, Konrád asks you, Henrik, how much of the families' fortunes was left after the crisis.
b2-21-03.prompt: Tell Konrád how much was left of the families' money.
b2-21-03.target: A családok pénze a felére csökkent.
b2-21-03.english: The families' money fell to half.
b2-21-03.canDo: I can compare sizes with kétszer akkora and háromszor annyi

b2-21-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What Konrád Saw
b2-21-04.scenario: After dinner, old Nini asks you, Konrád, what you saw in the far countries where you lived for years.
b2-21-04.prompt: Tell Nini what you saw there.
cues: Say what happened to the markets
b2-21-04.target: A világ másik felén láttam, hogyan alakulnak át a piacok.
b2-21-04.english: On the other side of the world I saw how the markets were changing.
b2-21-04.canDo: I can use átalakul, leépül, felzárkózik and megszilárdul to describe economic change

b2-21-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What Can Recover
b2-21-05.scenario: Near dawn in the hunting lodge, Konrád asks you, Henrik, whether everything can be put right again.
b2-21-05.prompt: Tell Konrád what can recover and what cannot.
b2-21-05.target: A gazdaság újra nőhet, de a bizalom nem.
b2-21-05.english: The economy can grow again, but trust cannot.
b2-21-05.canDo: I can present a short case study with rates (a háromszorosára nő, a felére csökken)

b2-21-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Prices and Money
b2-21-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the night, old Nini asks you, Henrik, to sum up what the crisis did to the prices and to the families' money.
b2-21-consolidation.prompt: Sum up for Nini what the crisis did.
cues: Say what happened to the prices
Say what happened to the money
b2-21-consolidation.target: Az árak a százszorosára nőttek, a családok pénze pedig a felére csökkent.
b2-21-consolidation.english: Prices rose a hundredfold, and the families' money fell to half.
b2-21-consolidation.canDo: I can say how many times something grew (-szorosára) and that two things are proportional (arányban áll)
